# scaffold

Manage project boilerplate via bundled scaffold templates.

How to use it, with examples: [Many projects](/cookbook/ecosystem).

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

### `fobis scaffold init`

Create all missing boilerplate in a new or existing repo.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT |  | Path to fobos configuration file |
| `--yes`, `-y` |  |  | Apply all changes without interactive prompts |

### `fobis scaffold list`

List all managed template files and their categories.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT |  | Path to fobos configuration file |

### `fobis scaffold status`

Show drift report: which managed files are up-to-date, outdated, or missing.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT |  | Path to fobos configuration file |
| `--files` | TEXT |  | Limit scope to files matching this glob pattern |
| `--strict` |  |  | Exit non-zero if any drift is detected (for CI use) |

### `fobis scaffold sync`

Update divergent managed files (shows diff + asks confirmation, or --yes to skip prompts).

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT |  | Path to fobos configuration file |
| `--dry-run` |  |  | Show what would change without writing any files |
| `--yes`, `-y` |  |  | Apply all changes without interactive prompts |
| `--files` | TEXT |  | Limit scope to files matching this glob pattern |

<!-- cli:end -->
